title: Developer Portfolio Ilse
text: My name is Ilse Bosman and I am a second-year Methodology, Statistics and Data Science master student at Utrecht University. I live in Utrecht and have also completed my my bachelor Interdisciplinary Social Science here. During my bachelor, I did two minors: Methods and Statistics in the Social and Behavioural Sciences and Social Policy and Public Health. Currently, I am following a Contemporary Psychometrics track.
